name: Require Test Coverage
description: Blocks git commit if test coverage is below a configurable threshold
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block commit if test coverage is below threshold
CMD="$1"
THRESHOLD=${COVERAGE_THRESHOLD:-80}
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  COVERAGE_OUTPUT=$(npx vitest run --coverage --reporter=json 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"pct":[0-9.]*' | head -1 | grep -o '[0-9.]*')
  if [ -n "$COVERAGE_OUTPUT" ]; then
    COVERAGE=$(echo "$COVERAGE_OUTPUT" | cut -d. -f1)
    if [ "$COVERAGE" -lt "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: Test coverage is ${COVERAGE}% (minimum: ${THRESHOLD}%)"
      exit 2
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
